scientific_question: Does the accepted square-corrected geometry-v3 image-label selector convert a minimally enriched, unconditionally merged proposal gallery into actual Dice closer to the frozen fully-supervised reference?

goal.primary: minimize the frozen fully-supervised Dice gap rather than require weakly supervised Dice above 0.5

proposal_feasibility_evidence.interpretation: candidate support is no longer the limiting ceiling if the two sources are appended without a GT router; actual selector Dice remains unknown

immutable_gallery_semantics.anchor: frozen LayerCAM plus BiomedCLIP component/SAM proposal gallery
immutable_gallery_semantics.merge: unconditional append followed only by exact binary-mask deduplication
immutable_gallery_semantics.prompt_metadata: the anchor LayerCAM prompt map scores every candidate so source-local saliency cannot act as a hidden router
immutable_gallery_semantics.source_identity: preserved only for audit and a separately predeclared later family-balanced arm
immutable_gallery_semantics.candidate_cap: bind the GT-blind exact maximum after complete train/validation generation; no truncation

execution_sequence.selector: accepted geometry-v3 checkpoint and square-corrected descriptor projection unchanged
execution_sequence.purpose: measure whether the existing learned scorer can exploit the new candidates without confounding from retraining

execution_sequence.authorization: run only after G0 is frozen/audited and regardless of proxy metrics; actual Dice is always evaluated
execution_sequence.change: same geometry-v3 model trained image-label-only on the same merged train gallery
execution_sequence.frozen: split, seed, fixed final epoch, optimizer, losses, square geometry, no GT model selection
execution_sequence.purpose: separate proposal-domain adaptation from proposal availability

evaluation.stage_a: freeze 371 continuous maps and candidate selections before any validation polygon is opened
evaluation.stage_b: actual binary-mask Dice and IoU over 184 tumors, including complete misses, with 94/72/18 subgroups
evaluation.secondary: paired complete-group bootstrap and candidate-source/count reliance diagnostics
prohibited: post-hoc threshold, source or epoch selection
SAM/pseudo-student rescue before the direct selector result is understood

coordination.reason: repository coordination forbids a competing related selector launch while R1 remains active; static code, tests and evidence preparation are allowed
coordination.next_action: after R1 terminal result, synchronize the complete log, register a unique gallery-supply claim, push it to the central branch, then launch
